issue_context.title: panic when running `kubectl diff` on malformed spec
issue_context.body:

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


**What happened**:
I tried to `kubectl diff` with a Deployment spec that was roughly shaped like this (note that the `imagePullSecrets` is invalid, since it should be a list of `LocalObjectReference` instead of `string`). This caused kubectl to fail to create a three-way patch and panic.
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: foo
  namespace: foo
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - foo-auth
```

An error is returned

The panic occurs on this line because `errOut` is nil:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/2bd9643cee5b3b3a5ecbd3af49d09018f0773c77/staging/src/k8s.io/kubectl/pkg/cmd/apply/apply.go#L915
